structured.feedback: The description is about 190 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come mostly from the listing and reviews, and it leaves out the "too thick" complaint, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split, the unsupported "slim" tip and "forged" wording, and the cuticle claim.
